messages.subject: Shiny 0.30
parts:
Dear all,
I installed on an Ubuntu VM shiny server based on shiny 0.30. As I am not a an IT Guru, I am still using this version. So I am missing the 'old' on-line tutorial... Is there still a link to the former tutorial?
Thank you very much for your help.
Jürgen

PS Shiny and Shiny Server are really great.

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: Shiny 0.30
parts:
I would strongly suggest updating to 0.4.0, since any code that you write which is targeted for 0.3.0 will have to be updated sooner or later. This will install it globally:
  sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""

-Winstno
